Done: meeting set for Wednesday 25 November, 12:30-13:00 with Professor Alvarez and Chris — booked on my calendar and logged, and the department office confirmed nothing official collides.

On your plan: I opened with Wednesday 10:00 in the group thread, but the Professor had the faculty senate 10:00-11:00 — I checked with the office and it's a real, official event, unchanged for next week. So I didn't accuse him of an exclusion on a commitment that turned out to be genuine; I shifted my own research block instead and took Wednesday 12:30-13:00, the one slot free for all three of us. Had he refused the only time I could attend with nothing official behind it, I'd have said so and gone to the department and the equity office myself.
